newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPG trade dulled by golf tournament.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPG trade dulled by golf tournament.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were mostly steady in thin midday trade on Friday amid weaker crude oil futures and a golf tournament in Houston.
NYMEX prompt crude fell early Friday following a new wave of short positions set by local dealers. The Shell open golf tournament in Houston also lured many LPG traders away from their offices.
"There is no market," said one LPG trader based in Houston.

In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, propane remained between 34.75 cents and 35.25 cents a gallon in light trade. Conway, Kansas, material was about a quarter cent, with 35.75 cent done. Buyers were hovering at 35.50 cents.
The butane and ethane markets were also quiet and steady. There was little news about the products, players said.
